scripts.check:comments: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),ts=require('typescript');const walk=(d)=>fs.existsSync(d)?fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap((e)=>{const p=path.join(d,e.name);return e.isDirectory()?walk(p):/\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs)$/.test(e.name)?[p]:[];}):[];const bad=[];for(const f of walk('packages')){const src=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const sc=ts.createScanner(ts.ScriptTarget.Latest,false,ts.LanguageVariant.Standard,src);let tok;while((tok=sc.scan())!==ts.SyntaxKind.EndOfFileToken){if(tok===ts.SyntaxKind.SingleLineCommentTrivia||tok===ts.SyntaxKind.MultiLineCommentTrivia){bad.push(f+':'+sc.getTokenPos());break;}}}if(bad.length){console.error('Comments found:',bad.join(', '));process.exit(1);}"
